echo: How does the harvest look this year?

lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
lines.text: Sure 'tis far too early for the harvest to show its face in March, with the grain barely in the ground yet! What brings ye out to the forge this fine mornin'?

lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron wipes his brow with a leather apron and grins.*
